interface.title: NIR Spectrum Manager
interface.field: Near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy / chemometrics, with CIE L*a*b* colorimetry (plant samples, e.g. Salicornia)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploratory analysis after measurement: data loading, quality control (outliers, duplicates), preprocessing, unsupervised exploration and a first calibration model
interface.what_it_is_for: A Streamlit app, with all text in Italian, that turns multi-block JDX NIR spectra in a project folder into SNV-corrected datasets: it screens outliers and duplicate reproducibility, runs PCA and Ward clustering, and fits a PLS model with leave-one-out validation against L, a or b colour values.

data.note: I uploaded nirlab_demo.jdx (10 spectra, Sal1–Sal9 plus Sal7bis, 1000–1700 nm) into a new project 'demo' and saved it to data/demo/raw/. After saving, the app automatically selected the saved file while the uploaded copy was still attached, so it read 20 spectra from 2 files. A save click then crashed the page with a ValueError in the PLS code at app_streamlit.py line 379 (screens/011.webp, 012.webp). Removing the uploaded copy brought it back to 10 spectra and fixed it (screens/013.webp). Sal9 has no L/a/b values.

tree.general: Turn a batch of NIR spectra with colour measurements into a cleaned, preprocessed dataset, then explore its structure and test whether spectra can predict a colour value
tree.specific: Go from a multi-block JDX file to SNV spectra, PCA, Ward clusters and a PLS model of L, a or b with LOO-CV

screens_never_reached: A Duplicati view for a second original/bis pair: the demo file has only Sal7/Sal7bis, so 'Coppia da visualizzare' has one option
A comparison of several sample-prefix groups: the sidebar lists 'confronto diretto multi-gruppo' only as a possible future step, and the demo has one prefix (sal)
not_done: Recording a reason for excluding Sal5: the interface only shows a tooltip saying exclusion must be justified; there is no field to store the reason
Choosing the number of clusters by hand: k is always picked automatically by silhouette and there is no control to override it
PLS with target 'a': I tried L and b, not a
Plotly chart tools (zoom, pan, legend toggling, PNG export): I did not test them; they are standard Plotly, not specific to this app

A bug I hit but did not investigate: after 'Salva file caricati' the saved file is selected automatically while the uploaded copy is still attached, so every spectrum is loaded twice. A save click then crashed the page with a ValueError at app_streamlit.py line 379 ('The truth value of a Series is ambiguous'). Removing the uploaded copy fixed it

PLS model quality on the demo data: cross-validated R² stayed negative in every run (best was −1.356 for L with 1 component after excluding Sal5), so I could not show a working calibration with this synthetic data
When I moved the max-components slider, the final-components stepper went back to 1 and had to be set again
